chunks: So they departed, talking in low voices:

key_terms.يَتَخَافَتُونَ: talking in low voices; whispering confidentially

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says they were talking in low voices?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as describing the Jinn who attended the Prophet Muhammad's recitation in the market of Nakhlah, their hushed whispers reflecting a mix of awe and cautious deliberation before returning to their people to warn them. This moment underscores the universal reach of the Quran, extending beyond humans to the unseen world, and highlights the immediate, albeit secretive, impact of divine revelation on those who witness it.
